__introCard.headline: One player short?
__introCard.sub: Keep a list of people you can call in, fill an open spot straight from the lineup, and see who said yes.

__outroCard.sub: Any member can call someone in. Admins keep the list under Team settings.

__intro: One player short? Call in a substitute.
Short of players for a training or a match? Call in a substitute.
Tuesday Training is one setter short. Op: Tuesday Training is one setter short. Let's open it.
The lineup shows every short position, w: The lineup shows each position that is short, and a way to fill it.
The substitutes who play setter come first, everyone else below.
Kees said yes, so mark him Going.
Someone new? Add them by name; they join: Asked someone who isn't on the list yet? Add them by name, and they join the event as Asked.
Done! The setter spot is filled.
Every substitute on the event sits under: Every substitute on the event sits under the lineup: going, asked, or can't.
Admins keep the list under Team settings: Admins keep the list tidy under Team settings.
Give Mila her position, so she is found: Give Mila her position, so she comes first the next time a libero is missing.
Rename, shirt number or remove: all in t: Rename, shirt number, or remove: it's all in the row's menu.
__outro: Try it today! Next time you are one player short, TeamBalance has you covered. See you at TeamBalance dot N L!
